# NovaMind AI — Operations & Service Performance Report

**Reporting Period:** Q2 2026  |  **Prepared by:** Operations Team  |  **Distribution:** COO, Portfolio Operations

## 1. Operating Expense Impact

| Metric                                   | Value   |
|------------------------------------------|---------|
| Pre-AI opex baseline (opex before AI)    | $42.0M  |
| Current opex (post-AI operating expense) | $38.8M  |

Total AI spend this quarter contributing to this opex reduction: $5.2M, yielding an AI-driven cost reduction of $3.2M (baseline operating expense minus post-AI operating expense).

## 2. Service Level Improvement

| Metric                              | Value   |
|-------------------------------------|---------|
| SLA pre-AI (baseline service level) | 78.0%   |
| SLA post-AI (current service level) | 96.0%   |

This represents an AI-driven SLA improvement of +18 percentage points, driven primarily by automation in the support resolution and finance close workflows.

## 3. Productivity Metrics

| Metric                                                     | Value           |
|------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------|
| Output pre-AI per FTE (baseline productivity per employee) | 120.0 units/FTE |
| Output post-AI per FTE (current productivity per employee) | 169.2 units/FTE |

## 4. Process Automation Coverage

AI-automated processes (processes automated by AI) this quarter: 41 of 100 total automatable processes identified in the operations process inventory, yielding a 41% automation coverage rate — up 8 percentage points quarter-over-quarter.

## 5. Adoption Score Trend

- **Adoption score current year** (this year's AI adoption score): 74.0
- **Adoption score prior year** (last year's AI adoption score): 66.0

## 6. Portfolio Weighting & Outcomes

Portco revenue weight (revenue weighting factor) for NovaMind within the broader portfolio: 0.28. Portco adoption score (company AI adoption score) this quarter: 74.0/100.

Total AI successful outcomes (AI outcomes delivered) this quarter: 14,820, supporting an AI ROI (return on AI investment) of 3.1x against total AI spend of $5.2M.

## 7. FTE Redeployment

34 FTEs were redeployed from AI-automated roles to revenue-generating or reskilled positions this quarter, out of approximately 50 FTEs whose roles were materially impacted by AI automation — a 68% redeployment rate, up 8 from the prior quarter.
